high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "shiv.bhaktgyan," which is located in Haridwar, as indicated by the profile information at the top of the post. The post features a grid of 12 icons, each representing a different Shiva temple or Jyotirlinga, which are sacred sites associated with Lord Shiva in Hinduism. Each icon includes a stylized depiction of the temple or the lingam (the phallic symbol of Shiva) along with the name of the temple beneath it. The temples listed are: Rameshwaram Tray
